method: Read-only review of inventory positions, recorded change/crop coordinates and existing source-line descriptions. No ink was reopened and no sort by element ID was used. Each proposal is a targeted relocation based on an explicit above/below relation, source line order or recorded start position. The proposed sequences leave the relative order of all other entries unchanged.
limits: Overlapping boxes on the same named line were not reordered solely because a right-hand crop starts slightly higher. Coincident overwritten layers retain their existing association. Where an adjoining drawing has no independent vertical coordinate, only the note with a recorded position receives a move proposal. Broad enclosing text/display entries remain with their local items unless an explicit raised item precedes the first baseline of that block.
